papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.authors: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar et al.
papers.abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks. This work proposes a new simple network architecture based solely on attention mechanisms.

papers.title: Global patterns of terrestrial biodiversity
papers.authors: Harold J. Newbold, Lawrence N. Hudson et al.
papers.abstract: A cross-biome synthesis of local biodiversity responses to land use and related pressures.

papers.title: The social life of urban public space
papers.abstract: An observational study of how design decisions influence informal interaction across shared city spaces.

notes.title: Transformer architecture — key claims
notes.content: Self-attention removes recurrence and makes the model significantly more parallelizable. Revisit the positional encoding ablation before literature review.

notes.title: Fieldwork sampling questions
notes.content: How do we distinguish temporary occupancy from sustained use? Consider three observation windows per location.

notes.title: Reading group: biodiversity measures
notes.content: Compare species richness against abundance-based intactness. The latter may be more responsive to land-use intensity.

projects.name: Thesis literature synthesis
projects.description: Map foundational and recent work on efficient sequence models.

projects.name: Urban commons field study
projects.description: Document patterns of informal activity in three neighborhood plazas.

projects.name: Biodiversity metric review
projects.description: Compare methods used to estimate local ecological intactness.

experiments.title: Baseline sequence classifier
experiments.description: Establish a reproducible recurrent baseline for comparison.
experiments.methodology: Train a two-layer BiLSTM across five fixed random seeds.
experiments.observations: Convergence is stable after epoch 12; variance is concentrated in minority classes.

experiments.title: Pilot observation protocol
experiments.description: Test the field observation rubric at one study site.
experiments.methodology: Two researchers independently coded activity at 15-minute intervals.
experiments.observations: Ambiguity arose between passing through and short informal stays.
